args.goal: Check full mission history for equivalent Innovative Solutions Canada work and reuse any valid results. Use the official ISED index and at most two original challenge notices to find one currently open funded challenge that can be met with a narrowly scoped offline data validation or reconciliation deliverable. Verify the closing deadline, intended applicant eligibility, funding instrument, deliverable and measurable acceptance criterion from the original notice. If the scope fits, execute one fictional passing case and one fictional failing case against the stated criterion. Save the exact source quotation, URL, hash, commands and actual results. Preserve tested work if applicant eligibility or contractual terms remain unresolved. Prepare an operator-ready response only when applicant eligibility, submission and payment terms are supported. If the index is inaccessible or no notice fits, record the actual coverage and reopen only on a first-party notice with a live deadline and a relevant funded scope. Read back the committed result and close under a valid lease with a lesson covering what worked, what failed and what to change. No external submission, spending or deployment.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
